content: First time either plugin has been run through the real claude CLI's own validator rather than only reasoned about by hand — caught a real, if minor, gap (missing agent description) that pure reading had missed, same pattern as the New-Trail.ps1 reject-code bug earlier. This CLI install and its local marketplace/plugin registration are separate from whatever this Cowork session's own agent-type list is caching (the originally-reported 'old agentskills-template-engine' issue) — that's still open and unrelated to this fix.
